title: feat(console): conversation focus — a pinned record in the chat request, shown as a chip, kept across navigation
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8MAKxxTRQgqLoecpeB9tVb4)_

Fixes #36999
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `capabilities.focus` is a flag the AI service declares on its agent catalog; no app author writes it, and no skill or hand-written doc teaches the catalog's capability set (only the generated reference, regenerated here)
Regen-provenance: merge of origin/main 6f3a8da2ac4975ff26f8015f76198d2286755185 via os-regen-merge.sh; regenerated artifacts only, no source change

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在服务端声明支持「钉住记录」的助手里，用户在记录页可以把对话钉在这条记录上，输入框上方显示记录名称并可取消；之后翻到别的页面，对话仍然问这条记录。服务端还没声明支持的环境（目前所有环境）一切照旧，用户无感。
- 为什么做：属于「记录范围 AI 问询」专题，替在一条记录上问 AI 的用户解决「一翻页助手就换了对象」的问题；服务端如何使用这条记录由云端子卡负责。
- 出错会怎样：只影响助手输入框上方那一行和发给助手的请求内容；服务端未声明支持时不出现任何新东西，这一面已有测试钉住；本改动可直接整体撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Contract (`packages/spec`)**

- `ToolExecutionContext.focus?: { object: string; id: string }[]` beside `surfaceContext` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`. Docblock per the card: client-reported and advisory, never an access decision; the server re-reads the record as the caller; at most one entry in phase 1; the name is `focus` because `scope` already means the conversation cache key.
- **The capability flag: `capabilities.focus`** — an optional boolean on the agent catalog row, `AiAgentCapabilitiesSchema` in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` (`GET /api/v1/ai/agents`). That catalog is the discovery the console already reads (`useAgents`), and its `capabilities` object is the precedent for per-agent behaviour flags (cloud#816: `authoring`, `canvas`, `debug`, `resume`). Optional, so every row served today still parses and reads as "not honoured". The cloud child mirrors it by adding `focus: true` to the rows of the agents whose route honours `context.focus`.

**Console (`ui/`)**

- **One request builder.** The page (`AiChatPage`) and the dock (`ChatDockConversation`) both mount the same `ChatPane`, whose `useObjectChat` `body.context` is the one per-turn builder; it now spreads `buildFocusContext(focus, honoured)`, which adds `focus: [{ object, id }]` while a record is pinned AND the agent declares `capabilities.focus`, and no key at all otherwise (a turn without a focus is byte-identical to today's).
- **Host-held state, one setter.** `useConversationFocus(conversationId)` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/chatFocus.ts`) is held by each host above the pane it keys on the conversation id, exactly like the composer's picked model, so the first send — which mints the id and remounts the pane — carries the focus (the carry happens during render, before the remounted pane's replay). The carry applies only to the id a first send goes to, or to the `setChatFocus` hand-off that landed before the host had an id. For the first send, each host sets a send mark beside `ensureConversation`, and only while it has a user to create for. The host's `createError` spends the mark, so a failed create carries onto nothing. A send recorded while the thread is still resolving keeps its mark, because the id that arrives is the one that send goes to. For the hand-off, only its own focus is carried: a chip pin of another record, a remove or a decline drops the carry. Any other id that arrives restores that conversation's own stored focus: a resumed thread, a history row, or the scope blanking the id between apps. The focus rides on the conversation and never re-keys it (the dock's thread-scope ruling holds). The stored copy is per tab (`sessionStorage`, like the drawer's own target) and only restores the chip. `setChatFocus({ object, id })`, exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`, is the setter every entry point calls: it applies to the chat host on screen, and with none mounted it waits for the next host to mount (pin, then open the drawer). The file imports no chat code, so the eager console graph can import it.
- **Composer row.** `ChatFocusRow` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ChatFocusRow.tsx`): while the agent honours a focus, the page chip (`console.ai.discussing`) is drawn with a pin when the page shows one record; once pinned, the focus chip replaces it with the record's display name (one `findOne` + the object definition, read in the browser as the user, `getRecordDisplayName`; an unreadable record keeps its `object · id` pair) and a remove control. Opening another record asks once 「改为问《X》？」 with Switch / Keep; a decline is remembered for the conversation.
- **Capability read.** `AgentCapabilities` in `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` gains `focus`, normalised from the catalog. `agentHasCapability`'s legacy `isBuildAgent(name)` fallback now covers only the four build-era capabilities, so `focus` is never inferred from a name.
- Locale keys `console.ai.focus.{pin,pinned,remove,switchPrompt,switchAccept,switchDecline}` in all eleven packs (zh-Hant generated by `gen:zh-hant`).

Changeset: `.changeset/36999-conversation-focus.md` (`@objectstack/spec` minor — `Metadata-protocol: added`, the new `AiAgentCapabilities` key the authorable-surface shard records; plugin-chatbot, app-shell, i18n patch).

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/chatFocus-36999.test.tsx` — real `ChatDockConversation` and real `AiChatPage` (`/ai/ask`), real `ChatPane`, `useChatConversation`, `useObjectChat`, `useConversationFocus` and `ChatFocusRow`; the pinned value is the JSON body of each POST to the agent chat route:

- the pin on the page chip pins the record; the first turn (which mints the conversation) and every later turn carry `focus`, across a navigation to a list page;
- opening another record asks once; a decline is remembered (a third record does not ask); accepting moves the focus;
- removing the focus: the next turn has no `focus` key and the page chip with its pin is back;
- a focus pinned on an unsent conversation does not follow the user into an existing one: opened from the history, that conversation shows and sends its own stored focus, and one with none shows and sends none;
- a first send whose create fails hands its focus to no conversation opened after it (the history row keeps its own focus and stored entry);
- a chip pin after a setter hand-off is the conversation's own: it does not follow the user into an existing one;
- a page with no one record offers no pin; `setChatFocus` before any chat is mounted is taken by the next host;
- the full-page chat: a focus set through the setter rides the first and second turn; removing it stops it;
- no flag (dock and page): no row, no pin, `promptHeaderSlot` undefined, no `focus` key even after `setChatFocus`; and the composer frame draws the page chip as before.

Also: `agentCapabilities.test.ts` (focus read from the declaration; no name fallback), `ai-agents-envelope.test.ts` (a row with `focus: true` parses, a row without it parses, a non-boolean does not).

## Acceptance notes

- **The chip's place, while the flag is on.** The card puts the focus chip in "the composer slot that draws the page chip today". That chip is drawn by `ChatbotEnhanced` in `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` from a text-only prop, so a pin or a remove control cannot be drawn on it without editing that component, which is outside this claim's file surface. While the agent declares `capabilities.focus`, the pane therefore draws the page chip (with its pin) and the focus chip in the composer's existing in-flow row above the input (`promptHeaderSlot`, where the drafts line sits) and passes no text chip; with no flag the chip stays on the input's top edge, unchanged. Keeping it inside the input frame is a small follow-up: a node slot on `ChatbotEnhanced`'s chip.
- **Decline scope.** 「a decline is remembered for the conversation」 is read as: after one decline, this conversation asks no more (for any record) until a focus is pinned again. Kept in the per-tab conversation state, never sent.
- **The full-page chat.** Every `/ai…` address now opens the dock filling the window (`AiAddressRedirect`); the exported `AiChatPage` page still hosts `ChatPane`, so it holds the focus the same way and the tests cover both.
- The drawer entry and the `ask_ai` action: call `setChatFocus({ object, id })` from `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` and `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAgents.ts` carry the flag (the discovery payload and the hook the console reads it with); `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` moves its census by the one new pair.

## First read

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/chatFocus.ts` — `useConversationFocus`: the render-time carry onto a minted id, and the `setChatFocus` host stack.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` — `focusHonoured`, the `buildFocusContext` spread in `body.context`, and the `composerContextRow` swap.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAgents.ts` — `NAME_IMPLIED_CAPABILITIES`: the legacy fallback no longer answers for `focus`.

## Verification (two minutes)

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/chatFocus-36999.test.tsx` → 11 passed; the request bodies carry `"focus":[{"object":"account","id":"rec_1"}]` only in the flag-on cases.
